items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: So as soon as I had a trumpet opening, I got Julius and Julius spent quite a while in the band

ctx.x: Now, would you like to say anything special about Yusef Lateef, who was Bill Evans then?
Yeah, his name was Bill Evans. We mentioned him before and he brought Julius Watkins, and he was another guy-- I tell you what though, he was studying but he

Muslim-minded then and he was very sincere and if you were ever around at five o'clock, they have to turn to the sun and pray, and he had a quiet concern (inaudible), he would ask me if it would be all right for the bus to stop and he would face the sun.
